title: Functional Outcomes and HRQoL in Upper-extremity Sarcoma Patients After Limb Salvage
brief_summary: This study aims to assess the functional ability and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) of upper extremity sarcoma patients who have undergone limb salvage surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Upper extremity soft tissue sarcoma locating in between scapula to arm
* No metastasis at the time of diagnosis
* Undergone limb salvage surgery
* A minimum of 6 months follow-up
* Written consent
* Age \> 18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18
* No limb-salvage surgery due to sarcoma
* Deceased
study_population: Upper extremity sarcoma patient who underwent limb-salvage surgery
